mechanism: Both drugs can cause renal impairment and hypocalcemia; zoledronic acid may potentiate valsartan's hypotensive effects, and combined use increases risk of acute kidney injury.
action: Monitor renal function (eGFR, creatinine) and electrolytes (calcium, magnesium) regularly; assess blood pressure; ensure adequate hydration before zoledronic acid infusion; consider dose adjustment if renal function declines.
